evidence_quotes: The department of commerce (commerce) is requesting to withdraw WSR 26-15-113 from its filing.
The withdrawal is only for the CR-102 portion of the rule making.
Commerce wants to provide more marketing and communications for the rule making to receive more public input on the program.
A new CR-102 will be filed with a new public hearing date and comment period in the coming weeks.
